note: A Class 1 poem about a horse. Three lessons: rhyming words, the first and last sound of a word, and the letters त, घ, ड़. Every question five words or fewer, in simple Hindi a Class 1 child reads alone (e.g. 'ताल और चाल मिलते हैं?'). Mix the right answers: at least one 'नहीं' in each lesson. Tag rhyme and sound lessons read1, letter lessons read2. Use your own words, not the poem's lines or the exercise's word list.
